s00018.summary: Grandpa Ezekiel amuses Pippa with tales of falling off boats while Junior scoffs.
Junior wants off the ferry; Ezekiel wryly says they are simply committed.

s00012.summary: Tired Birgitta does laundry late at night while Tobias pesters her for gummies.
Tobias offers his dinosaur to the lone girl, who critiques its brain.
Birgitta learns the girl has waited an hour and offers to call for help.
Noor panics and begs Birgitta not to call anyone.
Noor's father bursts in, and she runs into his arms.
The father explains and thanks Birgitta; Noor waves goodbye to Tobias.

s01103.summary: Cordelia leads frightened Artemus through the flooded asylum cellar.
Artemus's camera flash reveals a figure standing against the far wall.
Artemus begs to leave; Cordelia explains they came for patient forty-one.
A woman's lullaby drifts closer; Cordelia warns not to answer or look.
A hand seizes Cordelia's ankle, the lantern falls, and the flash reveals the ghost.

s01038.summary: Beside the casket, Kwan questions widow Eloise about the will's witness.
Kwan reveals the nurse denies being present; Brandao finds the statement.
Eloise asks for water and steadies her shaking hand.

s01083.summary: A voice from the library walls accuses Thessaly of stealing its book.
Kestrel reads the last page, which wakes the author; the book won't return.
The raven-headed Scribe materializes and claims the whole kingdom as his writing.
The Scribe's shadow writes Kestrel's name and foretells her death tonight.
Thessaly steps between them and slashes a barrier of ancient light.
Kestrel slams the book shut and refuses him; the Scribe dissolves into ink.
In the silence, Thessaly warns it isn't over; the book beats like a heart.
